established_constraints: Frontend: Nuxt 3 / Vue 3 (TypeScript, SPA Studio Mode, Pinia, TanStack Vue Query, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn Vue)
Backend: Express.js (Node.js v24.18.0, TypeScript) dengan pola Route -> Controller -> Zod -> Service (ServiceResult) -> Repository/Adapter
Database & Queue: SQLite (WAL mode) + Prisma ORM (siap migrasi PostgreSQL) + Persistent Local Job Queue tanpa ketergantungan VPS/Docker
Media Engine: Local FFmpeg 8.1.2-full_build & FFprobe via spawn(bin, argsArray, { shell: false }) - nol biaya cloud render
AI Integration: BYOK Multi-Provider terenkripsi AES-256-GCM (zero plaintext leak di UI/API/log)
Zero Hardcoded Master Data: Country, Age Group, Editing Style, Hook Type, Prompt Presets dikelola di tabel master_presets
